232-678-8249.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager.
Repeat.

4289-4770-4785-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

258-1409-5364-5696.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Jyoti.
258-1409-5364-5696.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
258-1409-5364-5696.description:
Activate Jyoti by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jyoti enters, it and Deadeye Navigator trigger.
Resolve the Jyoti trigger, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game
When the Forest Dryads enter, Tatyova triggers that many times, giving them haste until end of turn.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jyoti.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

628-895-2018.description:
Activate Darigaaz's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Darigaaz's Attendant dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Darigaaz's Attendant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Darigaaz's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Darigaaz's Attendant dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Darigaaz's Attendant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat

824-2728-2921-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-2921-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-2921-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 4.

4153-5147--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4153-5147--5--195.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Resourceful Defense trigger.
Resolve Resourceful Defense's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6747-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

849-1580-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3921-4762-7704.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doc Samson and Winding Constrictor.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1170-2440-4720-7499.description:
Cast the copy of Pest Friend from exile by paying {B/G}.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Lluwen, Exchange Student, which enters prepared.
When Lluwen, Exchange Student enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the spell from step 1, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} each time for each Pest you control.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1563-3499-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3007-3129-3899-4552.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
539-3007-3129-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Toymaker.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2919-3490-5231-6458.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2919-3490-5231-6458.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

224-1772-5621-6664.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

224-277-907-1772.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Tiller Engine and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

2511-5394-6291.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1170-1354-6203.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{G} if Throne of Eldraine's chosen color is not "Green"
1170-1354-6203.description:
If able, activate Throne of Eldraine's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast green monocolored spells.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Throne of Eldraine. Choose "Green" as it enters the battlefield.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a 0/0 Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
The Wurm enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat.

1003-2034-2055-3263.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Auriok Salvagers by paying {2}, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-3440-4867-4871.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying {1}{B}, targeting Cormela.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cormela.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice and Pitiless Plunderer triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the first Cormela trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cormela enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the second Cormela trigger, returning Demonic Gifts from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3, causing you to scry 1.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1978-3371-4893.notablePrerequisites: Codie does not have summoning sickness.
1978-3371-4893.description:
Activate Codie by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Codie.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand, and on subsequent turns.

877-3184-4645-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing The First Sliver, choosing any target.
Yomiji triggers, returning The First Sliver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Cast The First Sliver for {0}.
Resolve the First Sliver's cascade ability.
The First Sliver enters the battlefield.
Repeat.

2816-3088-5116.notablePrerequisites: Gilded Lotus and Xenic Poltergeist does not have summoning sickness.
2816-3088-5116.description:
Activate Xenic Poltergeist by tapping it, targeting Gilded Lotus.
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any one color.
Activate Umbral Mantle by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

654-1021-2034-2345.description:
Play Drownyard Temple triggering landfall.
Tap Drownyard Temple for {C}.
Use Embodiment of Insight to make Drownyard Temple a creature.
Sacrifice Drownyard Temple to Ashnod's Altar.
Play Drownyard Temple from your graveyard.
Amulet of Vigor untaps it.
Repeat.

1671-2026-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Voyaging Satyr.
1671-2026-3525.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat any number of times.
